acceptance: Native captured-context TestAlert0/1/2/255 and alert/APC order measured on four ABI views
Target context is restored before APC entry; API never overwrites restored result registers with fabricated status0
User alert consumption, FIFO/appending/nesting/cancellation/teardown and no per-guest host forwarding

assumptions.assumption: One build29683 ARM64 kernel/four ABI views bounds the observed contract.
assumptions.basis: Completed native-continue-v2:52captured-context resumes104postchecks48callbacks; corrected x86 wrapper PC/SP independently equal intended worker continuation.
assumptions.stress-test: False/nonzero byte values, preexisting alert with and without callbacks, appended callback and LastError mutation
assumptions.falsification-probe: Another ABI trace disagrees, source/PE/module drifts or any captured-context continuation differs

assumptions.assumption: Existing saved APC machinery can deliver against a newly restored context without retaining the replaced NtContinue frame.
assumptions.basis: begin_apcs captures current RegContext and returns Flow::Resume(saved); native callbacks occur before the target resume marker
assumptions.dependent-result: New explicit alertable resume flow and checked frame pruning
assumptions.stress-test: Different target PC/SP/GPRs, nested continuation from an APC, pending cancellation and bad context
assumptions.falsification-probe: A callback uses old source SP/context, a stale frame resumes, or restored GPR0 becomes fabricated status
assumptions.validation: Nine shared tests pass. The7pass1fail callback-replacement regression exposed a preexisting stale native continuation at equal stack height. Native and HLE now use the common ownership rule; full/native gates remain pending.

assumptions.assumption: The current one-argument Win32 APC producer and owned user alert bit remain the modeled queue/state boundary.
assumptions.basis: No native three-argument queue/alert producer is registered; prior alert group already states the boundary
assumptions.dependent-result: Reuse a single per-thread alert-priority policy for NtTestAlert and NtContinue
assumptions.stress-test: Preexisting alert suppresses initial APC delivery; false TestAlert leaves it pending
assumptions.falsification-probe: A supported producer requires another queue/state representation

bounded-findings.item: Full Windows guest exit remains unproved: smoke currently stops at NtContinue TestAlert1, whoami at virtual-memory class3.
Public Rust Flow gains an alertable resume variant; opaque C ABI/defaults/dependencies remain unchanged.
Native context replacement previously retained an abandoned APC continuation at the same stack height.
bounded-findings.evidence: continue-focus-c.json/log:7passed1failed at x86/TestAlert0; corrected shared ownership rule passes continue-focus-d9/0.

surface-map.direct-decode: Unaffected: no ISA encoding or decoder changes.
surface-map.direct-execute: Unaffected: existing CPU adapters apply architecture RegContext.
surface-map.cpu-state: Affected: checked replacement precedes APC capture; result registers retain supplied values.

surface-map.smir-lift-ir-interpreter-optimizer-lower: Unaffected: no instruction representation, lowering admission or JIT change. Native/full tests still exercise current upstream core.
surface-map.backend-machine-device-oracle: Unaffected: user process HLE and native-service scheduling only.
surface-map.c-abi: Opaque and unchanged; public Rust Flow enum adds ResumeAlertable.
surface-map.scheduling-lifecycle: Affected: shared user-alert priority and same-height context-pruning; cancellation and forced-exit coverage.
surface-map.windows-macos-linux: Same shared runtime sources compiled and executed by all three host gates. Windows-only test executes real installed native/WoW64 leaves.
surface-map.tests-docs: New shared/native modules registered in the existing library target; exact native replay is compiled via include_str. Documentation and primary/raw proof are separate from product source.
